metadata.title: EMA/CO for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia
metadata.indication: High-risk GTN (FIGO score 7 or above), low-risk disease after failure or relapse following sequential single-agent therapy, or low-risk disease after methotrexate failure with hCG above 1,000 IU/L.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.

indications.description: Low-risk GTN after failure or relapse following sequential single-agent methotrexate and dactinomycin.
Low-risk GTN after methotrexate failure with hCG >1,000 IU/L.

treatment.schedule_summary: Dactinomycin and etoposide are followed by methotrexate over 12 hours. Write down the infusion start time so you know when rescue begins. Return for dactinomycin and etoposide. Oral folinic acid starts today. The day 1 and 2 anti-sickness medicines form one course. Start the first oral folinic acid tablet 24 hours after the methotrexate infusion STARTS. Take four doses 12 hours apart unless your team gives you a different written rescue plan. If a tablet is late, missed or vomited, phone the unit straight away. Vincristine is given only into a vein, followed by cyclophosphamide. Tell the team about constipation or numbness before treatment. The full sequence repeats every 14 days.
